jobId.description: Becomes a directory name under `project-data/jobs/`. The pattern is defence in depth — `jobDir()` in @cutdown/skill-runtime guards and containment-checks it regardless of caller, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

edlId.description: The PlatformEDL to validate. Must be a ULID: it becomes a FILENAME under the job (and, for outputs, a directory that is created on the way), so a traversing value would read or write inside another job. The skill asserts it again before joining, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation and a schema-only guard has the same bypass shape the Phase 2 HIGH had.

recordedModelPath.description: Test/fixture only: a recorded critic response replayed over an injected transport.

boundsPath.description: Optional file with an array of {assetId, duration} AssetBounds. When absent, bounds are read from the job's SourceAsset preflight.

styleProfilePath.description: Optional StyleProfile whose prohibitedClaims are added to the prohibited-claim gate.
